description: Elopak ASA manufactures and supplies paper-based packaging system solutions for liquid products in Europe, the Middle East, Africa, Asia, Americas, Germany, Canada, Netherlands, Norway, the United States, and internationally. It offers Pure-Pak cartons for chilled and aseptic liquid food; D-PAK cartons for non food products for personal and home care; and filling equipment. The company also provides roll fed packaging material, as well as research and development support, after sales, technical training, and maintenance support services. Further, it offers machines and equipment through spare part webshop. Elopak ASA was founded in 1957 and is based in Oslo, Norway.
